spans.s: दक्ष (I) a. (f. क्षा) 1. Able, competent, expert, clever, दोग्धरि दोहदक्षे K.S.i.2, R.xii.11, Bhartr.i.88; 2. fit, suitable; 3. ready, careful, M.v.150; 4. honest, upright.

दक्ष (II) m. 1. Name of a son of Brahman (m.), the father of Pārvatī in her former birth, दक्षस्य कन्या भवपूर्वपत्नी K.S.i.21; 2. a cock; 3. fire; 4. the bull of Śiva; 5. a lover attached to many mistresses; 6. an epithet of Śiva.
दक्ष (I) a. (f. क्षा) 1. Able, competent, expert, clever, दोग्धरि दोहदक्षे K.S.i.2, R.xii.11, Bhartr.i.88; 2. fit, suitable; 3. ready, careful, M.v.150; 4. honest, upright.
दक्ष-अध्वरध्वंसक, -क्रतुध्वंसिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
दक्ष-अध्वरध्वंसक, -क्रतुध्वंसिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
दक्ष-कन्या, -जा, -तनया f. 1. an epithet of Durgā; 2. any lunar mansion (the 27 lunar mansions being considered to be so many daughters of Daksha).
दक्ष-कन्या, -जा, -तनया f. 1. an epithet of Durgā; 2. any lunar mansion (the 27 lunar mansions being considered to be so many daughters of Daksha).
दक्ष-कन्या, -जा, -तनया f. 1. an epithet of Durgā; 2. any lunar mansion (the 27 lunar mansions being considered to be so many daughters of Daksha).
दक्ष-सुत m. a god.
दक्षाय्य m. 1. A vulture; 2. an epithet of Garuḍa.
दाक्षाय्य m. A vulture.

दक्षिण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Able, competent, clever; 2. right, (op. to वाम); 3. southern; 4. straightforward, honest, impartial; 5. pleasing, amiable, agreeable; 6. liberal, courteous; 7. submissive; 8. situated on the right side; 9. situated to the south.

दक्षिण (II) m. 1. The right hand; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. a lover who is equally courteous to several mistresses (in poetic composition).(The inst. sing. दक्षिणेन is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘on the right side of,’ ‘on the south of,’ (with an acc. or gen.), अयि दक्षिणेन वृक्षवाटिकामालाप इव श्रूयते Sak.i.)

दक्षिण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Able, competent, clever; 2. right, (op. to वाम); 3. southern; 4. straightforward, honest, impartial; 5. pleasing, amiable, agreeable; 6. liberal, courteous; 7. submissive; 8. situated on the right side; 9. situated to the south.
दक्षिणा (I) ind. To the south, in the southern direction, (with an abl.).

दक्षिणा (II) f. 1. A prolific cow; 2. a present or gift to Brāhmaṇas on the performance of religious rites; 3. दक्षिणा considered (originally only in a figure) as the wife of a sacrifice, R.i.31; 4. gift, offering in general; 5. the south; 6. the Dekkan.
दाक्षिण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Relating to a sacrificial gift; 2. relating to the south.
दाक्षिण (II) n. A collection of sacrificial gifts.
दक्षिण-अग्नि m. the sacred fire in the household of a Brāhmaṇa, which is otherwise called अन्वाहार्यपचन.
दक्षिण-अग्र a. pointing to the south.
दक्षिण-अचल m. the southern mountain, i.e. Malaya.
दक्षिण-अभिमुख a. facing the south, directed southward.
दक्षिण-अयन n. the sun’s progress south of the equator, the half year in which the sun moves from north to south.
दक्षिण-अर्ध m. 1. the right hand; 2. the southern side.
दक्षिण-आचार a. 1. honest, well-behaved; 2. a worshipper of Śakti according to the right hand ritual.
दक्षिण-आशा f. the south.
दक्षिण-आशा˚पति m. an epithet of Yama.
दक्षिण-इतर a. 1. right (as hand or foot), K.S.iv.19; 2. northern.
दक्षिण-इतरा f. the north.
दक्षिण-उत्तर a. lying to the south and the north.
दक्षिण-उत्तर˚वृत्त m. the meridian line.
दक्षिण-तस् ind. 1. from the right, to the right hand; 2. southward, from the south.
दक्षिण-पश्चात् ind. to the south-west.
दक्षिण-पश्चिम a. south-western.
दक्षिण-पश्चिमा f. the south-east.
दक्षिण-पूर्व, -प्राच् a. south-western.
दक्षिण-पूर्वा, -प्राची f. the south-east.
दक्षिण-पूर्व, -प्राच् a. south-western.
दक्षिण-पूर्वा, -प्राची f. the south-east.
दक्षिण-समुद्र m. the southern ocean.
दक्षिण-स्थ m. a charioteer.
दक्षिणा-अर्ह a. deserving a fee, worthy of a gift.
दक्षिणा-आवर्त a. 1. curved to the right; 2. turned towards the south.
दक्षिणा-काल m. the time of receiving dakshiṇā.
दक्षिणा-पथ m. the southern portion of India, the Dekkan, अस्ति दक्षिणापथे विदर्भेषु पद्मपुरं नाम नगरम् M.M.i.
दक्षिणा-प्रवण a. inclining to the south.
दक्षिणाहि ind. 1. Far on the right; 2. far in the south, (with an abl., e.g. दक्षिणाहि ग्रामात्).
दक्षिणीय m. A Brāhmaṇa fit for a sacrificial fee. (Also दाक्षिण्य and दाक्षिण्य.)
दाक्षायणी f. 1. Any one of the 27 lunar mansions; 2. name of Aditi, wife of Kaśyapa and mother of the gods; 3. an epithet of Pārvatī; 4. the lunar constellation called Revatī.
दाक्षायणी-पति m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. the moon.
दाक्षायणी-पुत्र m. a god.
दाक्षिण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Relating to a sacrificial gift; 2. relating to the south.
दाक्षिणात्य (I) a. (f. त्या) Belonging to or living in the South, southern.
दाक्षिणात्य (II) m. 1. A southerner, a native of the Dekkan, e.g. आरंभशूराः खलु दाक्षिणात्याः; 2. the cocoanut.
दाक्षिणात्य (I) a. (f. त्या) Belonging to or living in the South, southern.
दाक्षिणिक a. (f. की) Connected with a sacrificial gift.
दाक्षिणिक a. (f. की) Connected with a sacrificial gift.

दाक्षिण्य n. 1. Politeness, courtesy, kindness, दाक्षिण्योदकवाहिनी विगलिता Mrich.viii., Mal.v.; 2. the state of relating to or coming from the south, स्नेहदाक्षिण्ययोर्योगात् कामीव प्रतिभाति मे Vikr.ii. (where the word is used in this sense and in sense 1); 3. honesty; 4. cleverness, talent.
दाक्षी f. 1. A daughter of दक्ष; 2. name of the mother of Pāṇini.
दाक्षी-पुत्र m. Pāṇini, the great grammarian.
दाक्षेय m. A metronymic of Pāṇini.
दाक्ष्य n. 1. Cleverness, skill, ability, Bg.xviii.43; 2. probity, integrity.
